one_line: Regulators tighten AI rules, firms confront oversight, and model development progresses.

themes.title: US Treasury expands AI investment curbs
themes.text: The U.S. Treasury proposed broader outbound investment restrictions on Chinese AI and biotech firms and extended the program to Cuba, Iran, North Korea and Russia, with a comment period ending Dec. 7.

stories.headline: US Treasury proposes expanding investment curbs on Chinese AI and biotech firms

themes.title: India regulator launches AI sandbox
themes.text: SEBI announced a graded compliance framework for brokers, creation of an AI sandbox for testing tools, and a market‑making mechanism for tokenised corporate bonds.

stories.headline: SEBI to introduce graded broker compliance, AI sandbox, and corporate bond reforms

themes.title: AI firms face oversight scrutiny
themes.text: Two Google DeepMind researchers resigned over concerns about oversight of its Pentagon AI contract, and an OpenAI researcher was mocked for suggesting air‑gapped AIs could communicate via CPU temperature.

stories.headline: Two Google DeepMind researchers resign over Pentagon AI contract, oversight concerns
OpenAI researcher mocked for claim air‑gapped AIs could communicate via CPU temperature

themes.title: Advances in AI model development
themes.text: OpenAI resumed training of frontier AI models after a security overhaul, and Block released Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs locally on consumer‑grade GPUs.

stories.headline: OpenAI resumes training of frontier AI models after security overhaul
Block releases Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs locally
